_doc: Data-driven config for programs/watchdog-systray.nix — a KDE system-tray applet (Wayland-native StatusNotifierItem via python3+AyatanaAppIndicator3) exposing the system-protection stack: live status, a manual OOM trigger, the escape-hatch keybind reminder, and a log viewer. Plus a companion NixOS tray. All labels/commands/units live here; the .nix only wires them. `menu` = ordered list of {label, icon, command} rendered as the SNI's Gtk menu (a trailing Quit entry is always appended by the nix); `default_command` is run on primary (left-click) activate, independent of the menu.

oom._comment: Manual OOM trigger. kernel_sysrq=true uses the in-kernel SysRq OOM killer (echo f > /proc/sysrq-trigger) — the SAME action as the Alt+SysRq+F keybind, works even under heavy load (needs kernel.sysrq bit 64, set via sysctl). Falls back to killing the biggest non-essential RSS hog if sysrq is unavailable.

menu.label: Nix Daemon: RESET (restart)
menu.command: bash -lc '/run/wrappers/bin/sudo systemctl restart nix-daemon.service && notify-send "NixOS" "nix-daemon reset (killed + restarted)"'

menu.label: RESET daemon
menu.command: bash -lc '/run/wrappers/bin/sudo systemctl restart docker.service && notify-send "Docker" "docker daemon reset (killed + restarted)"'
